scope: Primary-source verification of available shortcut identities. This does not establish which firmware/mobile build is installed, physical gesture behavior, real-phone delivery or battery use.

phoneDefinitions.finding: All eight shortcuts have independent assignable watch preferences.

phoneSettingsSection.finding: All eight preferences are included in the phone Quick Launch section.

firmwareDispatch.finding: Non-Timeline apps launch with APP_LAUNCH_QUICK_LAUNCH, a representative button and the gesture action. COMBO plus BACK identifies Back+Up; COMBO plus UP identifies Up+Down.

watchSettingsMenu.finding: The native watch settings menu lists four holds and two taps. Combination assignments are exposed by the phone settings.

publicApi.finding: launch_get_quick_launch_action returns NONE, HOLD, TAP or COMBO; launch_button supplies button identity for Quick Launch.

appClickInitialization.finding: Each app initializes its own click manager.

clickReleaseHandling.finding: Initialized recognizers have is_button_down=false; an unmatched release returns before ordinary click recognition. Open Activity subscribes an ordinary Back single-click, not a raw release handler. Static review therefore found no obvious launch-hold release that would cancel the helper. Physical gesture timing remains a device check.

validationRule: Accept only the eight action/button pairs listed above; do not infer a hold from an unsupported or absent gesture.

independentReview.scope: Read-only code review plus targeted navigation, launcher and settings-page test files; no physical watch or real phone claim.
checks: Native and phone use action 1/2/3 with the exact eight representative-button pairs.
Unsupported tap/combo pairs and missing wire gesture close without resolving a destination.
The shared UI serializes all eight independent mappings using the same canonical ordering as the backend.
Existing schema1 Up/Down overrides and saved Default role survive load without a storage write.
New slots inherit the saved Default until explicitly configured.
Ordinary opening remains unchanged; Back cancellation remains an ordinary fresh single-click handler.
remainingDeviceChecks: Release a physical Hold Back or Back+Up launch without a new Back press and confirm opening proceeds.
While Opening is visible, make a fresh Back press and confirm cancellation before dispatch.
